description: Part 10 (Capstone) H0b - unblocker probe, DBVER-2 half (design section H0 step 5; risks 2 and 6 in section J). Run AFTER part10-00-probe. DEVIATION FROM THE ORCHESTRATOR NOTE, on purpose: the TXMIGR TO(2) steps run against <USER>B (library2 '*B'), the same target part05-txmigr-to2/to2b used, NOT against <USER>2. TXMIGR has no downgrade and only TXSETUP FORCE plus a DLTF of JUCHUM/JUCHUL1 (see PRECLEAN) returns a library to the v1 layout, so keeping the migration off <USER>2 means the batches 10-01..10-04 keep the DBVER 1 state of <USER>2 recorded by part10-00-probe. The tools (TXSETUP/TXLEGACY/TXRESET/TXMIGR, helper TX10RUN) are compiled into <USER>2 and act on <USER>B via the TOOL/TGT parameters, so TXMIGR's recompile-every-*PGM step (Step 3) touches only <USER>B programs, never the helpers. Flow (one wrapper job, before/after materialised into VFY10CNT / VFY10TXT / VFY10OBJ in <USER>2): gate rows B0-* record DBVER (TXSTATUS lines in VFYLOG) and JUDLV column presence of BOTH libraries; PRECLEAN drops JUCHUL1 and JUCHUM in <USER>B; TXSETUP FORCE(*YES) rebuilds the v1 sample DB there (B1-V1 must show 4 columns, 0 JUDLV); TXSETUP writes TXSTATE only when the data area does not exist yet (a leftover TXSTATE=2 from to2b or an earlier run of this batch stays), so ST1RAW records the raw TXSTATUS and SETDBV1 then sets TXSTATE to 1 by hand before ST1LIB2; TXLEGACY FORCE(*YES) loads the legacy programs into <USER>B; the ticket-1 fix is copied into MEMBER JU0900C of the target library (from staging member JU09T1, which the file steps upload into the default library, not into library2) BEFORE TXMIGR runs, because TXMIGR recompiles every RPG/CLP *PGM from its member and would otherwise bring the 3,0 bug back and make an RPG0907 look like a DBVER-2 effect; TXRESET at v1 (8/12 rows); step 5 v1 half: column-list INSERT then DELETE; TXMIGR TO(2) (B5-POST-MIGR / B6-POSTMIGR: JUDLV column present now; TXSTATE is NOT written by TXMIGR, TXSTATUS after TXMIGR still says DBVER=1 until CHGDBVER sets it by hand, as to2b did); step 5 v2 half: (a) the four-column INSERT with JUDLV omitted - outcome AND stored JUDLV value recorded in VFY10TXT (SQL0407 or a default; the tag shows which), (b) INSERT with an explicit DATE for JUDLV; JUCHUL1 (LF) is deleted and recreated as to2b did; TXRESET at DBVER 2 (B7-V2-RESET: load_v1.sql inserts JUCHUM rows without JUDLV, so this is the same experiment at scale; 8/12/6 rows if it works, recorded either way); finally, as the LAST cl step (hang rule), JU0900C PARM('*TEST' <USER>B) at DBVER 2: ZA0500 declares JUCHUM as 'IS F 26 DISK' while the v2 record is longer, the outcome (12 lines or an RPG/CPF error) is recorded, not assumed. The sh steps build the clone tree (src/legacy, db/v1, db/v2, db/data) by heredoc upload into staging members plus CPYTOSTMF CCSID 1208, the way part05-txlegacy-exec and part05-txmigr-to2 did. NEVER re-run this batch on its own expecting the earlier state: after it <USER>B is at the v2 layout with TXSTATE=2; re-running is safe (PRECLEAN + TXSETUP FORCE rebuild v1 first) but repeats the migration.

steps.label: MK10CNT
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE &LIB/VFY10CNT (TAG VARCHAR(20), ITEM VARCHAR(30), N INTEGER)') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: PRECLEAN
steps.cmd:
DLTF FILE(&LIB2/JUCHUL1)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
DLTF FILE(&LIB2/JUCHUM)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)

steps.label: C1COLSB
steps.cmd: RUNSQL SQL('INSERT INTO &LIB/VFY10CNT SELECT ''B1-V1'', ''JUCHUM cols'', COUNT(*) FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA = ''&LIB2'' AND SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME = ''JUCHUM''') COMMIT(*NONE)

steps.label: C1DLVB

steps.label: FIXMBR
steps.cmd: CPYSRCF FROMFILE(&LIB/QCLSRC) TOFILE(&LIB2/QCLSRC) FROMMBR(JU09T1) TOMBR(JU0900C) MBROPT(*REPLACE)

steps.label: CPJU0900C
steps.cmd:
DLTPGM PGM(&LIB2/JU0900C)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000)
CRTCLPGM PGM(&LIB2/JU0900C) SRCFILE(&LIB2/QCLSRC) SRCMBR(JU0900C) REPLACE(*YES)

steps.sql: SELECT TAG, ITEM, N FROM &LIB/VFY10CNT ORDER BY TAG, ITEM
SELECT TAG, TXT FROM &LIB/VFY10TXT ORDER BY TAG, TXT
SELECT TAG, OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJCREATED FROM &LIB/VFY10OBJ ORDER BY TAG, OBJNAME

SELECT ORDINAL_POSITION, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE, LENGTH, IS_NULLABLE, COLUMN_DEFAULT FROM QSYS2.SYSCOLUMNS WHERE SYSTEM_TABLE_SCHEMA = '&LIB2' AND SYSTEM_TABLE_NAME = 'JUCHUM' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION
